mechanism: Deutetrabenazine may cause orthostatic hypotension and QT prolongation, while eplerenone is a potassium-sparing agent that can elevate serum potassium, creating additive cardiovascular and electrolyte risks.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, ECG, and serum potassium levels regularly; assess need for dose adjustment or alternative therapy if hypotension or hyperkalemia develops.
